policy: New paper stakes: at most 40% committed overall, 10% per sport, 2% per game and 1% per ticket. At most 10% committed beyond 24 hours. Sportsbook NBA/NFL game lines may use 7.5% per sport, leaving 2.5% of bankroll for props within the 10% sport limit. Percentages use the lower of initial bankroll and current cash plus open stakes; profits do not automatically increase limits. Existing locked tickets remain intact, and may exceed new limits until settlement. Model and sportsbook accounts stay separate. Separate $10,000 paper bankrolls. One ticket per agent/game/market (player props: per player and stat, settled only from official box scores; did-not-play props are void and refunded); additional existing unit and prop sub-limits also apply. Quotes must be <=90 minutes old, saved before acceptance and before tip. Soccer three-way winners grade draws as wins only for the draw selection; supported half-line totals and full-game two-way markets retain their contracts. Uncalibrated strategy assumptions; no real wagers.

syndicates.policy: Top three profitable eligible founders per competition; 10+ settled games, positive ROI. Each founder joins one cohort for life. Two descendants per founder lifetime, maximum 16 new profiles; no recursive breeding. Each descendant starts new $10,000 paper bankrolls and zero results in both competitions. Counts and profit stay separate; descendants are correlated rule-based strategies.
